name: OverflowMenu

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the container node / ['aria-label']?: string; /** Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the container note.

props.name: flipped
props.description: `true` if the menu alignment should be flipped.

props.name: focusTrap
props.description: Enable or disable focus trap behavior

props.name: iconClass
props.description: The CSS class for the icon.

props.name: innerRef
props.description: The ref to the overflow menu's trigger button element.

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version. For use on $ui-01 backgrounds only. Don't use this to make OverflowMenu background color same as container background color.

props.name: menuOffset
props.description: The adjustment in position applied to the floating menu.

props.name: menuOffsetFlip
props.description: The adjustment in position applied to the floating menu when flipped.

props.name: menuOptionsClass
props.description: The class to apply to the menu options

props.name: open
props.description: `true` if the menu should be open.

props.name: renderIcon
props.description: A component used to render an icon.

props.name: selectorPrimaryFocus
props.description: Specify a CSS selector that matches the DOM element that should be focused when the OverflowMenu opens

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the OverflowMenu. Currently supports either `xs`, `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg` as an option.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon OverflowMenu rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
